summaries.en: Build-Your-Own-X is a curated collection of tutorials that teaches programming by recreating technologies from scratch, helping developers understand system internals through hands-on implementation. Its technical insight lies in breaking down complex systems into learnable components, demonstrating how foundational concepts combine to create sophisticated tools. You can use it to build anything from databases to games, gaining practical skills while exploring how your favorite tools work under the hood—perfect for deepening your programming knowledge through active creation.
summaries.zh: Build-Your-Own-X 是一个精心编排的教程集合，通过从零开始复现各种技术来教授编程，帮助开发者通过动手实践理解系统内部原理。其核心方法是将复杂系统分解为可学习的组件，展示基础概念如何组合成复杂工具的技术思路。你可以用它构建从数据库到游戏的各种项目，在探索常用工具底层原理的同时获得实用技能——这种“边做边学”的方式非常适合想要通过主动创造来深化编程理解的开发者，为技术成长提供了一条清晰的实践路径。

summaries.en: Workerd is the open-source JavaScript/WebAssembly runtime engine that powers Cloudflare Workers, enabling developers to deploy serverless applications at the network edge for ultra-low latency. Its technical innovation lies in implementing the V8 JavaScript engine in a secure, isolated sandbox environment that can execute code across thousands of lightweight threads simultaneously. Developers can use it to build edge-native applications like API gateways, real-time data processing pipelines, or A/B testing frameworks by writing standard JavaScript/TypeScript that runs directly on Cloudflare's global network infrastructure.
summaries.zh: Workerd 是 Cloudflare Workers 背后的开源 JavaScript/WebAssembly 运行时引擎，它让开发者能够在网络边缘部署无服务器应用，实现超低延迟响应。其核心技术在于将 V8 JavaScript 引擎封装在安全的沙箱环境中，支持数千个轻量级线程同时执行代码，这种设计既保证了性能又确保了隔离性。开发者可以用它构建边缘原生应用，如 API 网关、实时数据处理管道或 A/B 测试框架，只需编写标准的 JavaScript/TypeScript 代码即可直接在 Cloudflare 的全球网络上运行，非常适合需要快速全球部署的场景。

summaries.en: Claude-HUD is a Claude Code plugin that provides real-time visibility into AI assistant operations, addressing the 'black box' problem where users can't see what tools or agents are active during complex tasks. It works by creating a persistent status line that displays context usage, active tools, running agents, and todo progress as Claude processes requests. Developers can install it via Claude Code's plugin system to monitor AI workflows, debug agent behavior, or optimize context usage in coding, research, or automation projects where understanding the AI's step-by-step process is valuable.
summaries.zh: Claude-HUD是一款Claude Code插件，通过实时状态栏将AI助手的工作过程可视化，解决操作不透明问题。它可显示上下文使用情况、活跃工具、运行中的智能体及任务进度，帮助用户在编程调试、研究分析等复杂任务中监控AI行为、优化上下文分配，特别适用于多步骤AI协作场景，使智能过程可观察、可优化。
